version: Magic ToDo on goblin.tools (web, v3.14.1 shown in the page footer), no account
genus: Breaks a chore into small steps
free_tier: Everything on the website, no account, no published limit
paid_from: $3 a month (Goblin Tools Pro: saved and synced lists, sharing)
licence_note: No licence terms for the generated lists are published.
launched_note: Not published; described in a 2023 blog post.
test: Typed 'Clean the garage' into Magic ToDo and clicked Break down once at spiciness 1, 3 (the default) and 5, each in a fresh browser.

conditions.value: 1 at each of 3 spice levels (1, 3, 5), no retries

runs.observed: 6 sensible steps: trash out, sort into boxes, sweep, wipe surfaces, mop, put things back.
11 steps; adds sorting into keep, donate, sell or trash, and setting up shelves and hooks. Useful.
33 steps. Drifts from cleaning into repairs: patch holes and cracks, repaint, fix and oil the garage door. Repeats itself (sweep twice, remove trash three times).

seconds_note: From clicking Break down until the last step appeared on the page (our script's clock); 1.1 s at level 1, 1.7 s at level 3, 2.5 s at level 5.
verdict_reason: Free, no account and instant: levels 1 and 3 turned one vague chore into a useful plan in under 2 seconds. Level 5 pads the list with repairs and repeats, so pick a middle level.
lesson: Start at level 2 or 3. Level 5 breaks things down so far that it starts adding jobs you never asked for.

deductions: needs manual fixes to be usable (repeats: sweep twice, trash three times) -8
adds work outside the task (repairs, repainting, oiling the door), counted as a factual error -10

score.notes: Work drawer. Quality (50 + 50 + 32) / 3 = 44. Speed: 2.5 s, under 60 s = 15. Free plan: no login 5, no published limit (more than 20 a day) 10, the full feature free 10 = 25. Price: $3 a month = 10.
